session_id.description:
Identifies this session. Send it as each event's `session_id` on the
events call.

page_instance_guid.description:
Identifies this page view. Send it as `data.page_instance_guid` on
every event.

plugins.description:
The offers to render. **An empty array is a valid, successful
no-fill** — render nothing and continue.

Creative.description: The renderable content of the offer.

instance_guid.description:
Use as the event `parent_id` when reporting an impression or view of
this creative.

copy.description:
Renderable copy, keyed by field name. Commonly used keys:

- `creative.title` — headline
- `creative.image.src` — image URL
- `creative.disclaimer` — disclaimer text
- `creative.termsAndConditions.link` — terms link
- `creative.privacyPolicy.link` — privacy policy link

Treat this as an open map: the keys available depend on the campaign,
and reading an absent key should degrade gracefully rather than fail.

response_options_map.description:
The actions a customer can take, keyed by role — typically `positive`
and `negative`.

fonts.description: Fonts referenced by the offer, when the account uses them.

ResponseOption.description: One action a customer can take on an offer.

instance_guid.description:
Use as the event `parent_id` when reporting that the customer chose
this option.

token.description: Event token for this response option.

action.description:
What the option does, e.g. `Url` to navigate, `CaptureOnly` to record
the choice without navigating.

is_positive.description: Whether this option represents acceptance of the offer.

SessionToken.description:
A refreshed reference to the session. Read it back from every response and
use the latest value on subsequent calls.

Slot.description: A position in the layout, holding at most one offer.

instance_guid.description: Use as an event `parent_id` when reporting on the slot.
